Marketing Coordinator (Entry Level)
Tidewater Coffee Roasters

Responsibilities
• Plan and schedule social media posts across our channels
    ◦ Instagram
    ◦ TikTok
    ◦ LinkedIn
• Support in-store events from start to finish:
    ◦ Coordinate with store managers on dates, staffing, and supplies
    ◦ Design flyers and signage in Canva for each event
    ◦ Collect sign-ups and send follow-up emails after each event
• Write product descriptions for the online store and keep
  them consistent with our brand voice

Requirements
• Proficiency in at least one of the following:
    ◦ Canva
    ◦ Adobe Photoshop
    ◦ Figma
• Strong writing and editing skills
• Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience

Nice to Have
• Experience with email marketing tools:
    – Mailchimp
    – Klaviyo
• Basic photography skills
